faqQOpen: Why can't I find or open my file?
faqQCreate: How can I create a new file?
faqQPrint: How can I print a file?
faqQSubscription: How do I manage or cancel my subscription?
faqQAds: Why are there ads in the app?
faqQSlow: Why does a file open slowly?
faqQPermissions: Why does the app need file access permission?
faqAEdit: Open the Tools tab and tap Edit PDF, then pick a file. You can edit existing text, add new text, add images, annotate (highlight, underline, strike-through, draw) and add your signature. Tap the check mark to save a copy.
faqADisplay: While reading, use the bottom bar to switch between vertical and horizontal scrolling, rotate the view or invert colors. Pinch to zoom, and tap the page number to jump to a page.
faqACopy: Copying text isn't available yet. We're working on it! If this matters to you, send us feedback so we can prioritise it.
faqASearch: Open the document and tap Search in the bottom bar, then type the word you're looking for. Use the arrows to move between results. To find a file by name, use the search icon at the top of the home screen.
faqAOpen: Make sure the app has permission to access your files. If the file is in a cloud app or another folder, open it with your file manager and choose this app. If a file still won't open it may be damaged or password-protected; please tell us.
faqACreate: On the All files page tap the + button. You can create a document from a template, import files, convert images to PDF or scan paper documents with your camera.
faqAPrint: Open a PDF, tap the ⋮ menu and choose Print. Other formats can first be converted to PDF from the Tools tab.
faqASubscription: Subscriptions are managed by Google Play. Go to Settings → Manage subscriptions, or open Google Play → Profile → Payments & subscriptions. See our Terms of use for details.
faqAAds: Ads help us keep the app free for everyone. You can remove them with Premium.
faqASlow: Very large files or files with many images take longer to load. Closing other apps and freeing storage space can help. If a file is always slow, please send us feedback.
faqAPermissions: The app needs file access only to find and open the documents on your device. Your files stay on your device and are never uploaded.

The App is provided "as is". We do our best to keep it reliable, but we do not guarantee that it will be error-free, and we are not liable for loss of data. Please keep backups of important files.
